entities.summary: The University of Souk Ahras Mohamed Chérif Messaadia is a university located in Souk Ahras, Algeria. It was founded in 1998 as an annex within the university of Annaba. In 2011, it was officially promoted to an accredited university with six faculties and two institutes.
